oneLiner: Turn what's already in your fridge into a delicious week of meals.
problem: People waste food and money because they don't know what to cook with the ingredients they already have, and meal planning feels like a chore.
targetUser: Busy home cooks (25-45) who want to reduce food waste, save money, and eat home-cooked meals without the mental load of planning.
coreFlow: User adds ingredients they have in their fridge/pantry
App generates a personalized 7-day meal plan using those ingredients
User reviews and tweaks the plan (swap meals, adjust servings, mark dislikes)
App produces a consolidated shopping list for missing items
User saves the plan and can export or share it

screens.name: My Fridge
screens.purpose: Quickly add, edit, and organize available ingredients with smart suggestions and quantities.

screens.name: Weekly Plan
screens.purpose: View and interact with the auto-generated 7-day meal plan, including swap and regenerate options.

screens.name: Meal Details
screens.purpose: See full recipe, steps, time, and nutritional info for a selected meal.

screens.name: Shopping List
screens.purpose: Review missing ingredients aggregated from the meal plan, with checkboxes for shopping.

screens.name: Preferences
screens.purpose: Set dietary restrictions, allergies, cuisine likes/dislikes, and household size to personalize plans.

outOfScope: Barcode scanning or photo-based ingredient recognition
Multi-user household accounts or collaborative planning
